card.name: Range words in drug interaction data
card.fires_on: The word "range" in parentheses after a mean percent change in AUC, and "to" or "subjects" inside numeric ranges or study-group descriptions in interaction-study text.

modes.label: range in parentheses
modes.description: The word range opening a bracketed span after a mean change in AUC or exposure.

modes.label: to between numbers
modes.description: The word to linking two numbers in a span of percent change or dose.
modes.example: 7.3 Digoxin Mean decreases of 16%<< to>> 22% in serum digox

modes.label: study subjects
modes.description: The word subjects after a count or group in an interaction study.
